full_prompt_en: A square highly rendered fighting-game portrait shows a stern man with towering black hair, amber glasses, and a thick fur-collared coat against a dark gray studio background. The crop is tight, cutting through his upper chest and the highest hair tips so the face and collar occupy nearly the entire frame. His hair rises in two broad sharp peaks with many individually visible dark strands and a pronounced V-shaped hairline. Heavy angular eyebrows press over narrowed eyes that stare straight outward. Thin metal-framed glasses with brown lenses sit low on the nose, revealing the intense eyes above their upper edge. Deep forehead creases, sharp cheek structure, and close facial stubble reinforce the severe expression. A gray high-neck underlayer encloses the base of his throat. Around it, a worn leather coat opens into a wide tawny fur collar, the coarse strands catching warm highlights on both sides of the face. Small seams, scuffs, and red-brown accents appear along the coat near the lower corners. The background is a smooth charcoal gradient, without location detail or readable text, and helps the dark hair separate only where a faint rim light catches it. Strong frontal light from slightly above picks out the forehead, nose, lips, glasses, and individual fur strands, while deep shadow remains under the brow and along the left side of the jaw. The rendering is precise and almost sculptural, contrasting glossy lenses, textured skin, rough hair, matte cloth, and dense fur. The overall composition is confrontational and symmetrical, with exaggerated hair and collar framing a hard, immovable gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形精细渲染的格斗游戏肖像呈现一名神情严厉的男子，头发高高竖起，戴琥珀色眼镜，穿厚毛领外套，背景是深灰色影棚空间。裁切很近，画边穿过上胸和最高的发梢，因此脸与衣领几乎占满画幅。头发竖成两个宽大尖峰，深色单根发丝清楚可见，发际线形成明显的V形。粗重有棱角的眉毛压在眯起的双眼上，目光直望画外。细金属框棕色镜片低架在鼻梁上，强烈眼神从镜片上缘露出。深刻额纹、锐利面颊结构和短短胡茬强化严峻表情。灰色高领内层包住喉部。一件磨旧皮外套在颈部敞开，形成宽阔黄棕色毛领，粗硬绒毛在脸两侧接住暖高光。外套靠近下方两角可见小型接缝、擦痕与红棕色点缀。背景是平滑炭灰渐层，没有地点细节或可读文字，仅在微弱轮廓光碰到发丝处与深发分开。略偏上方的强正面光挑亮额头、鼻子、嘴唇、镜片和单根绒毛，眉下及下颌左侧仍留深影。渲染精确且近乎雕塑化，对照发亮镜片、带肌理皮肤、粗硬头发、哑光布料和浓密毛皮。整体构图对抗性强且对称，以夸张发型和毛领框住坚硬不动的目光。
style_prompt_en: The highly rendered digital image uses sculptural light to define exaggerated angular forms and tactile material contrasts. Warm tan, weathered brown, cool gray, and charcoal make a tight palette, with amber highlights adding restrained color. Crisp focal edges and very fine local texture describe skin, hair, fur, leather, and reflective surfaces at different levels of sheen. A smooth dark gradient removes environmental distraction, while slight rim light separates dark masses from the ground. Strong frontal illumination creates sharp small highlights and deep recessed shadows. The composition is compact and nearly symmetrical, pushing expression and texture toward the viewer. The overall effect is powerful, polished, and confrontational.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅精细渲染的数字图像用雕塑般的光界定夸张棱角形体和可感材料对照。暖棕黄、风化棕、冷灰与炭色组成紧凑配色，琥珀高光增加克制色彩。清晰焦点边缘与极细局部肌理以不同光泽描绘皮肤、头发、毛皮、皮革和反光表面。平滑暗色渐层移去环境干扰，微弱边光把深色体块从底色中分开。强正面照明形成锐利小高光与深凹阴影。构图紧凑且接近对称，把表情和肌理推向观者。整体效果有力、精致而具有对抗性。
theme_en: A fierce fighter in amber glasses and a heavy fur-collared coat
theme_zh: 戴琥珀色眼镜、穿厚毛领外套的凶悍格斗者
name: Tekken
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
